$comment: The download sites BackIssue can install, one entry per site. The app reads this to list what is available and to compare against what is installed. `download` points at a zip of that site's folder; the release workflow builds one per site and attaches them to the tagged release.

sources.name: Atsumaru
sources.description: Manga chapters from Atsumaru. Plain requests, no account and no browser build needed.

sources.name: MangaDex
sources.description: Manga chapters from MangaDex, with language and scanlation-group preferences. A series added from the hosted metadata service maps straight to its chapters.

sources.name: MangaTaro
sources.description: Manga chapters from MangaTaro. Plain requests, no account needed.

sources.name: WeebCentral
sources.description: Manga chapters from WeebCentral. The site is behind Cloudflare, so set the FlareSolverr URL in Settings → Downloading.

sources.name: GetComics
sources.description: Direct downloads from GetComics: single issues and multi-issue packs, from its own server with PixelDrain as a fallback.
